Dehydrated Parsley Flakes for Food Processing and Export

Dehydrated parsley flakes are dried, cut parsley leaves used to add a fresh herb note and green colour to seasonings, soups, sauces and snacks. Tradenest Naturals supplies food-grade dried parsley leaves to food manufacturers, seasoning brands, restaurant groups, importers and private label businesses. The flakes have a clean green look, a typical herbal aroma and an even 8-16 mesh flake size that behaves the same way in every batch. As a dehydrated parsley leaves bulk supplier based in India, we handle wholesale orders, export shipments and custom packaging.

Our dried parsley leaves are made from carefully selected parsley sourced from trusted growers. The leaves are cleaned, dehydrated, inspected and sieved, which helps keep their natural green colour, aroma and culinary value. They can go straight into dry seasoning blends, soups, sauces, marinades, instant noodles, bakery items, snack coatings and ready-to-cook products. B2B buyers can order standard bulk supply, retail-ready packs, private label dried parsley leaves or OEM packing for their own markets.

Product Overview and Functional Benefits

Parsley is valued in kitchens around the world for its fresh, green flavour and the colour it brings to a dish. Drying takes out most of the water and turns it into an ingredient that is much easier to store, portion, ship and standardise than fresh herbs. Added to a recipe, the flakes release a familiar parsley note and leave visible green herb pieces in the finished product. They suit year-round production where a stable herb format is needed.

  • Food-grade dried parsley leaves for high-volume commercial and culinary use
  • Consistent 8-16 mesh flakes for dry mixes, spice blends and prepared foods
  • Supply for domestic customers, international export and contract packing
  • Pack sizes for food processors, distributors, foodservice operators and retail brands

Sourcing and Processing Steps

Tradenest Naturals follows controlled processing practices so that the product stays consistent and every batch can be traced. Raw parsley is bought against set quality criteria, then cleaned and sorted in several stages to remove foreign matter and poor material. The cleaned leaves are dehydrated at controlled temperatures, inspected, cut and sieved. Packing is done in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials that stand up to long export routes.

We can adjust parameters to suit your colour expectations, end use, packaging format and destination-market rules. For industrial buyers of bulk dried parsley leaves, our team can work through specifications, sample evaluation, documents and repeat-supply planning with you before the order is confirmed.

Typical Technical Specifications

The values below are typical commercial specifications. They are confirmed against the approved product specification sheet, which is shared with every quotation, and the purchase order. Results can vary slightly with the crop and the season.

  • Form: Dehydrated parsley leaf flakes
  • Mesh: 8-16 mesh flakes
  • Moisture: Not more than 8%
  • Processing: Dehydrated, cut and sieved
  • Colour: Green to dark green, depending on the crop and processing conditions
  • Ingredients: Dehydrated parsley leaves only, unless a custom formulation is agreed
  • Additives: No added colours, artificial flavours or synthetic preservatives in the standard product

If you need a different particle size, a tighter moisture target, allergen declarations or destination-specific documents, please tell us at the quotation stage. Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI and IEC registered and does not claim other certifications. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Commercial Applications

Dried parsley leaves work both as a flavour ingredient and as a visual garnish. The light, free-flowing flakes dose accurately by hand or on automated lines. Typical uses include:

  • Dry seasoning blends, herb mixes, pasta seasonings, pizza toppings and soup bases
  • Instant soups, sauces, gravies, noodles, rice mixes and ready-to-cook meal kits
  • Savoury snack coatings, baked goods, crackers, namkeen and extruded snacks
  • Marinades, salad dressings, dips, spreads and prepared food mixes
  • Frozen convenience foods, processed meats and large-scale foodservice recipes
  • Retail herb jars, refill pouches, private label spice ranges and culinary kits

Buyer Value

  • Much longer storage life than fresh parsley when packed and stored correctly
  • Less preparation, trimming and handling labour in kitchens and factories
  • Steady supply for year-round recipes and fixed production schedules
  • Lower freight weight and simpler inventory than fresh herb logistics
  • Packaging formats for wholesale, foodservice, retail and export distribution
  • Technical help with product selection, sample assessment and application matching

Quality Control, Packaging, and Shelf Life

Our quality checks focus on raw material review, hygienic cleaning, moisture control, visual inspection, batch identification and pack integrity. Each shipment travels with batch details and the standard commercial paperwork for the destination market. Please share any import rules, labelling requirements or allergen controls before production so we can plan for them.

We use food-grade, moisture-resistant, tamper-evident packaging that protects the flakes from humidity, contamination, light and crushing. Standard sizes are 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg, along with bulk bags and custom export formats. Private label printing, custom labels and contract packing are available.

Shelf life is 18 months from the date of manufacture when the product stays sealed in its original packaging and is stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and strong odours. The expiry date is printed on the approved label and documents. After opening, reseal the pack promptly and use clean, dry scoops to keep the aroma and colour.

MOQ, Sampling, and Export Supply FAQs

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for dehydrated parsley flakes? The MOQ is 5 Kg. That lets you test the flakes in your own recipes before committing to larger volumes. Private label, OEM and custom printed packaging runs may need larger quantities so that printing and production stay economical.

What packaging and shelf-life options are available? You can choose foodservice packs, wholesale cartons, bulk bags, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers or custom printed private label packaging. Shelf life is 18 months under recommended storage, and the exact date is printed on the label.

What certifications and quality standards apply? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. We work to documented hygiene practices, batch traceability, inspection routines, moisture control and standard operating procedures. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on specification and artwork approval, the crop cycle, raw material availability and any custom documents, and we confirm it in the quotation. To request a sample or quote, send your quantity, packaging format, destination country, end use and labelling needs. Our team will review the details and send a full supply proposal.

Why Partner with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals is a B2B food ingredient supplier working with food processors, FMCG brands, restaurants, exporters, importers, wholesalers and young consumer brands. Our capabilities include dehydration, sieving, bulk packing, private label packing, formulation support and export documentation support. We keep specifications transparent, reply quickly and plan for long-term supply.

Whether you need a dependable dried parsley leaves supplier for ongoing production, an exporter for international distribution or a private label packer for a retail range, our team can match the product to your operational and commercial goals. Contact Tradenest Naturals with your target volume and specifications to ask for current pricing, availability, samples and export details.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated parsley flakes?

Orders start from 5 Kg, so you can evaluate the flakes before scaling up. Bulk, OEM and private label runs can be planned for larger volumes.

Which applications are dried parsley flakes suitable for?

They are used in dry seasoning blends, pasta and pizza seasonings, instant soups, sauces, noodles and rice mixes, snack coatings and crackers, marinades, dressings and dips, frozen convenience foods, and retail herb jars or private label spice ranges.

Can the flake size be customised?

Our standard product is 8-16 mesh flakes. If your application needs something different, tell us and we will check what is feasible.

What packaging options are available?

Parsley flakes can be supplied in bulk bags or HDPE containers, with pack sizes such as 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg. Private label packs can be arranged on request.

How can I request a sample or quotation?

Send your quantity, packaging format, destination country and application on WhatsApp. Samples are available on request, and we will share a quotation with the product specification sheet and export documentation details.
